title: feat(plugin-chatbot): an AI chat answer computed from a dataset shows which dataset and metrics it used
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XTfnpANDWSRVQfEQTS9xCwV)_

Fixes #33734

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

Seat `domain:ui#2` · os-project-manager · card thread `session_01FEkQ5kWtEXh64E1jg6WPCD` · claim 6892143272

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：AI 对话里答案下方折叠的「计算方式」块，过去只认对象查询（`query_records` 等）的 `source`；现在 AI 通过 `query_dataset` 按指标回答时，同一位置显示所用的数据集、每个指标（名称旁附机器名与口径说明）、分组维度和问题追加的筛选条件。对象查询的显示完全不变。
- 为什么改：ADR-0149 D3 规定指标答案的来源从工具返回的 `provenance` 块渲染，规格 `DatasetProvenanceSchema` 也写明「An answer renders its source from this block」，但界面一直只读 `source`，指标答案没有结构化来源块（cloud PR #4557 的发现）。
- 风险与回滚：纯前端读取与显示；`detectAnswerSource` 的返回类型与导出类型 `AnswerSource` 放宽为两种来源的联合类型（Clause-② 放宽，见下）。浏览器缓存重载时数据集来源写回 `provenance` 键。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/AnswerSource.tsx（新增 `DatasetSourceSection`；对象查询的筛选渲染抽成共用的 `AnswerSourceFilter`，输出不变）、ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/mapMessages.ts（`detectAnswerSource` 先读 `provenance`）、ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useChatConversation.ts（缓存写回键）。
- 两分钟验证：在已接入 `query_dataset` 的环境问一个指标问题（如「本月营收多少」），展开答案下的「计算方式」：应看到「数据集」「指标」「分组依据」「筛选条件」四行；问一个普通记录问题，块内容与今天相同。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（Clause-② 放宽，席位先补契约复审记录）。

## What changes

- **Lift.** `detectAnswerSource` (`mapMessages.ts`) reads a tool result's top-level `provenance` through `DatasetProvenanceSchema` first, then the object-query `source` through `ObjectQuerySourceSchema`, as before. Each is the schema's parse: an undeclared key is stripped, and a block the schema refuses is no block. `query_dataset` answers only `provenance`; the object-query tools answer only `source`.
- **Draw.** `AnswerSource.tsx` gains `DatasetSourceSection`, chosen by the block's `kind: 'dataset'`:
  - **Dataset**: the dataset's label (its name where the label is empty);
  - **Metrics**: each measure's label, with its name beside it when the two differ, and its `description` (the business definition ADR-0149 D1 asks for) under it when declared; the name alone where the label is empty;
  - **Grouped by**: the dimensions' labels, when any were selected;
  - **Filter**: `runtimeFilter` lowered to rows exactly as the object-query filter is (now one shared `AnswerSourceFilter`), or drawn as served when it does not lower; with no `runtimeFilter`, "No filter added to the dataset definition", because the dataset's own `filter` still applies and is never served (the schema says so), so "All records" would be false.
  - No "Only records visible to you" line: the provenance block carries no scope member, and the block states only what the producer sent.
- **Object-query rendering is unchanged.** `AnswerSourceSection` draws the same rows, test ids and words; the filter markup moved into `AnswerSourceFilter` byte for byte. The 31868 pin file passes unchanged.
- **Cache.** `sanitizeChatMessagesForCache` (`useChatConversation.ts`) writes a dataset lift back under `provenance` (the producer's key), an object-query lift under `source` as before, so both hydration paths lift it again on reload.
- **Types.** `AnswerSource` is now declared in `mapMessages.ts` as `ObjectQuerySource | DatasetProvenance` and re-exported from `index.tsx` under the same name.
- **Strings.** `chatbot.answerSource.dataset`, `metrics`, `noAddedFilter` in all 11 packs (`all-locales-key-parity`); zh-Hant generated from zh-Hans (`gen:zh-hant`). "Grouped by" and "Filter" reuse the existing keys.
- **Docs.** One sentence in `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx` beside the paragraph that describes the block (seat amendment 2).
- **Published surface, each a `Clause-②: yes (widening)` on `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`:**
  - `detectAnswerSource`'s return type: `ObjectQuerySource | undefined` → `AnswerSource | undefined`;
  - the exported type `AnswerSource`: was `ObjectQuerySource`, now `ObjectQuerySource | DatasetProvenance`;
  - `ChatbotEnhancedToolInvocation.answerSource` (in `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`, the one type line the seat approved): `ObjectQuerySource` → `ObjectQuerySource | DatasetProvenance`;
  - `AnswerSourceBlockProps.sources[].source` (package-internal, not exported from the entry): the same union.
  - A consumer that reads `object` / `filter` / `scope` off an `AnswerSource` narrows on `kind` first. In this repository the only consumer outside the package, `useChatConversation.ts`, does.
- Changeset `.changeset/33734-answer-source-dataset-provenance.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/console` patch (a widening with `Metadata-protocol: none` ships `patch`; app-shell is private and console's `dist` ships it).

## Tests

- `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.answerSource-dataset-33734.test.tsx` (turns built from wire parts through `uiMessageToChatMessage` and drawn by the real `ChatbotEnhanced`, the block opened by clicking its rendered trigger). The fixture is a `query_dataset` answer `QueryDatasetOutputSchema` accepts (asserted):
  - the lift returns the provenance alone, an undeclared key and the rows stripped; a provenance the schema refuses (wrong `kind`, string `measures`, string `dataset`) lifts nothing;
  - a `query_dataset` answer shows the dataset, each metric (label, name beside it, description), the grouping and the filter rows; no object-query section, no scope line, nothing of the rows or args;
  - no `runtimeFilter` and no dimensions: the "no filter added" line, no grouping row, never "All records";
  - a nested filter is drawn as served;
  - a turn with a dataset answer and an object-query answer: one block, both sections, in call order;
  - CONTROL: an object-query answer draws as today (object, filter row, records, scope) with no dataset section;
  - CONTROL: a `query_dataset` refusal (no provenance) draws no block;
  - the shipped zh pack (数据集 / 指标).
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useChatConversation.test.tsx`: a `query_dataset` provenance survives sanitize, JSON round-trip and both hydration paths (`hydratedMessagesToChatMessages`, `uiMessageToChatMessage`), and the cached part's `output` is `{ provenance }`.
- **Red first** on base bd96ec9c (production files restored to base, tests at head): 7 failed / 84 passed; every positive pin red (the rendered ones: "Unable to find ... button ... How this was computed"; the lift: "expected undefined to deeply equal { kind: 'dataset', ... }"); the controls and the refused-provenance pin green, as they must be. Head: 91/91 over the new file, the 31868 file and `useChatConversation.test.tsx`.
- **Ablations** through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (ui vitest aliases `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` to `src`, no rebuild), each mutation landing on disk, each restored with the blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty, running the same three files (91 tests):
  - the lift ignores `provenance`: 7 failed — every dataset pin and the reload pin;
  - no dataset section (the branch ANDed with an always-false term): 5 failed — every rendered dataset pin;
  - cache writes a dataset lift under `source`: 1 failed — the reload pin;
  - metric name beside the label dropped: 1 failed — the "shows the dataset, each metric" pin;
  - CONTROL leg, every block routed to the dataset section: 8 failed — the new object-query CONTROL, the mixed-turn pin and six 31868 object-query pins;
  - CONTROL leg, the empty-turn guard removed: 6 failed — the no-provenance CONTROL, the 31868 "no source draws no block" pin and the off-contract pins.

## Acceptance notes

- **Not delivered: the "non-metric reading" label on a fallback.** `DatasetProvenanceSchema` has no member that marks a fallback (`kind` is only `'dataset'`). Per ADR-0149 D3 rule 4 a fallback answer is an object-query answer (`query_records` / `aggregate_records`), and its 「非指标口径」 words are the producer's, inside `source.line`, which today's block does not draw. Labelling every `ObjectQuerySource` block would mislabel plain record reads and change the object-query rendering this order froze. The seat ruled the leg out of this PR and files the follow-up (it needs a producer or spec marker first).
- The metric's `description` is drawn because it is the sentence ADR-0149 D3 says explains what the number includes; the order listed label, dataset and filters.
- No scope line on a dataset section: the provenance carries none. The dataset query runs under the caller's context, but the block does not state what the producer did not send.
- `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`: two lines only (the type import and the `answerSource` member type), approved by the seat; this branch is rebased onto main after #33746 merged, as the seat ordered.

## Verification

<details><summary>Local gates, type-check, lint and suites</summary>

- Head ee612b49 (rebased onto 4b5024de after #33746 merged; the rebase was clean). `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 71 families for this diff. All 71 exit 0 on ee612b49, run sequentially after rebuilding the spec, formula, client, lint, sdui-parser and client-react closures and the `@object-ui/app-shell^...` closure (lock VERDICT command-exit 0). `--ran`: 71 derived, 71 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
- Suites under the lock, from `ui/` with `--maxWorkers=2`: `packages/plugin-chatbot/` + `packages/i18n/` 203 files, 2878 passed, 13 skipped; `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/` + `packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/` 153 files, 1255 passed.
- `pnpm run type-check` in `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot`, `ui/packages/i18n` and `ui/packages/app-shell`: exit 0 each.
- ESLint on the changed source, test and locale files: 0 errors; the 58 warnings are all on lines this diff does not touch (`react-refresh/only-export-components` and friends in `index.tsx`, `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`, `useChatConversation.ts`). `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (from `ui/`): exit 0.
- The same union was green on the pre-rebase heads (90a3f1ea for the 40 code families, ac1ae487 for the 31 docs families).
- `origin/main` moved 8 commits after 4b5024de (to c87e2ad2), among them #33801, which adds `chatbot.tool.list_datasets` / `query_dataset` labels to the same eleven packs in another block, and the 18.5.0 version-packages commit. `git merge-tree` of HEAD with c87e2ad2 is clean; the full app-shell suite and the rest of the farm are CI's.

</details>
